origins.body_en: Not formally described (not in IPNI or WCVP, checked 2026-10-03). In Exotica Esoterica, Jay Vannini presents it as A. queremalense (ined.), apparently restricted to mid-elevation cloud forest around the old Cali–Buenaventura road and elsewhere in Valle del Cauca, western Colombia. He places it in the A. marmoratum species complex and notes it is easily confused with A. marmoratum.

origins.body: Anthurium hookeri は 1841 年、Kunth が Enum. Pl. 3: 74 で記載した。分布はフランス領ギアナ、ガイアナ、オランダ領アンティル、スリナム、トリニダード・トバゴ、ベネズエラ、ベネズエラ領アンティル諸島、ウィンドワード諸島。
origins.body_en: Described by Kunth in Enum. Pl. 3: 74 (1841). Distribution: French Guiana, Guyana, Netherlands Antilles, Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago, Venezuela, Venezuelan Antilles, Windward Islands.
